description: This file defines a custom layout class for use with WearableListView, handling visual changes based on the list item's center proximity.

classes.name: WearableListItemLayout
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout that updates its child views' appearance depending on list position in WearableListView.

methods.name: WearableListItemLayout
methods.description: Constructors initializing layout with context and optional attributes; retrieves resource-based styling values.

methods.name: onFinishInflate
methods.description: Initializes references to child views after layout inflation.

methods.name: onCenterPosition
methods.description: Updates visual state when the item is centered in the list, highlighting it.

methods.name: onNonCenterPosition
methods.description: Reverts visual changes when the item is no longer centered.
